                          AREA ||i.cmp_lfn||, CODE, READONLY, ALIGN=2

                  cmp_lfn PROC
;;;1198   static
;;;1199   int cmp_lfn (			/* 1:Matched, 0:Not matched */
000000  b5f0              PUSH     {r4-r7,lr}
;;;1200   	WCHAR *lfnbuf,		/* Pointer to the LFN to be compared */
;;;1201   	BYTE *dir			/* Pointer to the directory entry containing a part of LFN */
;;;1202   )
;;;1203   {
000002  4603              MOV      r3,r0
000004  460a              MOV      r2,r1
;;;1204   	UINT i, s;
;;;1205   	WCHAR wc, uc;
;;;1206   
;;;1207   
;;;1208   	i = ((dir[LDIR_Ord] & ~LLE) - 1) * 13;	/* Get offset in the LFN buffer */
000006  7810              LDRB     r0,[r2,#0]
000008  f0200040          BIC      r0,r0,#0x40
00000c  1e40              SUBS     r0,r0,#1
00000e  eb000180          ADD      r1,r0,r0,LSL #2
000012  eb0105c0          ADD      r5,r1,r0,LSL #3
;;;1209   	s = 0; wc = 1;
000016  2600              MOVS     r6,#0
000018  2401              MOVS     r4,#1
;;;1210   	do {
00001a  bf00              NOP      
                  |L5.28|
;;;1211   		uc = LD_WORD(dir+LfnOfs[s]);	/* Pick an LFN character from the entry */
00001c  4817              LDR      r0,|L5.124|
00001e  5d80              LDRB     r0,[r0,r6]
000020  5c10              LDRB     r0,[r2,r0]
000022  4916              LDR      r1,|L5.124|
000024  5d89              LDRB     r1,[r1,r6]
000026  4411              ADD      r1,r1,r2
000028  7849              LDRB     r1,[r1,#1]
00002a  ea402701          ORR      r7,r0,r1,LSL #8
;;;1212   		if (wc) {	/* Last char has not been processed */
00002e  b17c              CBZ      r4,|L5.80|
;;;1213   			wc = ff_wtoupper(uc);		/* Convert it to upper case */
000030  4638              MOV      r0,r7
000032  f7fffffe          BL       ff_wtoupper
000036  4604              MOV      r4,r0
;;;1214   			if (i >= _MAX_LFN || wc != ff_wtoupper(lfnbuf[i++]))	/* Compare it */
000038  2dff              CMP      r5,#0xff
00003a  d207              BCS      |L5.76|
00003c  4629              MOV      r1,r5
00003e  1c6d              ADDS     r5,r5,#1
000040  f8330011          LDRH     r0,[r3,r1,LSL #1]
000044  f7fffffe          BL       ff_wtoupper
000048  42a0              CMP      r0,r4
00004a  d007              BEQ      |L5.92|
                  |L5.76|
;;;1215   				return 0;				/* Not matched */
00004c  2000              MOVS     r0,#0
                  |L5.78|
;;;1216   		} else {
;;;1217   			if (uc != 0xFFFF) return 0;	/* Check filler */
;;;1218   		}
;;;1219   	} while (++s < 13);				/* Repeat until all chars in the entry are checked */
;;;1220   
;;;1221   	if ((dir[LDIR_Ord] & LLE) && wc && lfnbuf[i])	/* Last segment matched but different length */
;;;1222   		return 0;
;;;1223   
;;;1224   	return 1;						/* The part of LFN matched */
;;;1225   }
00004e  bdf0              POP      {r4-r7,pc}
                  |L5.80|
000050  f64f70ff          MOV      r0,#0xffff            ;1217
000054  4287              CMP      r7,r0                 ;1217
000056  d001              BEQ      |L5.92|
000058  2000              MOVS     r0,#0                 ;1217
00005a  e7f8              B        |L5.78|
                  |L5.92|
00005c  1c70              ADDS     r0,r6,#1              ;1219
00005e  4606              MOV      r6,r0                 ;1219
000060  280d              CMP      r0,#0xd               ;1219
000062  d3db              BCC      |L5.28|
000064  7810              LDRB     r0,[r2,#0]            ;1221

                  f_lseek PROC
;;;2834   
;;;2835   FRESULT f_lseek (
000000  e92d47f0          PUSH     {r4-r10,lr}
;;;2836   	FIL *fp,		/* Pointer to the file object */
;;;2837   	DWORD ofs		/* File pointer from top of file */
;;;2838   )
;;;2839   {
000004  4604              MOV      r4,r0
000006  460e              MOV      r6,r1
;;;2840   	FRESULT res;
;;;2841   
;;;2842   
;;;2843   	res = validate(fp->fs, fp->id);		/* Check validity of the object */
000008  88a1              LDRH     r1,[r4,#4]
00000a  6820              LDR      r0,[r4,#0]
00000c  f7fffffe          BL       validate
000010  4682              MOV      r10,r0
;;;2844   	if (res != FR_OK) LEAVE_FF(fp->fs, res);
000012  f1ba0f00          CMP      r10,#0
000016  d002              BEQ      |L18.30|
000018  4650              MOV      r0,r10
                  |L18.26|
;;;2845   	if (fp->flag & FA__ERROR)			/* Check abort flag */
;;;2846   		LEAVE_FF(fp->fs, FR_INT_ERR);
;;;2847   
;;;2848   #if _USE_FASTSEEK
;;;2849   	if (fp->cltbl) {	/* Fast seek */
;;;2850   		DWORD cl, pcl, ncl, tcl, dsc, tlen, ulen, *tbl;
;;;2851   
;;;2852   		if (ofs == CREATE_LINKMAP) {	/* Create CLMT */
;;;2853   			tbl = fp->cltbl;
;;;2854   			tlen = *tbl++; ulen = 2;	/* Given table size and required table size */
;;;2855   			cl = fp->sclust;			/* Top of the chain */
;;;2856   			if (cl) {
;;;2857   				do {
;;;2858   					/* Get a fragment */
;;;2859   					tcl = cl; ncl = 0; ulen += 2;	/* Top, length and used items */
;;;2860   					do {
;;;2861   						pcl = cl; ncl++;
;;;2862   						cl = get_fat(fp->fs, cl);
;;;2863   						if (cl <= 1) ABORT(fp->fs, FR_INT_ERR);
;;;2864   						if (cl == 0xFFFFFFFF) ABORT(fp->fs, FR_DISK_ERR);
;;;2865   					} while (cl == pcl + 1);
;;;2866   					if (ulen <= tlen) {		/* Store the length and top of the fragment */
;;;2867   						*tbl++ = ncl; *tbl++ = tcl;
;;;2868   					}
;;;2869   				} while (cl < fp->fs->n_fatent);	/* Repeat until end of chain */
;;;2870   			}
;;;2871   			*fp->cltbl = ulen;	/* Number of items used */
;;;2872   			if (ulen <= tlen)
;;;2873   				*tbl = 0;		/* Terminate table */
;;;2874   			else
;;;2875   				res = FR_NOT_ENOUGH_CORE;	/* Given table size is smaller than required */
;;;2876   
;;;2877   		} else {						/* Fast seek */
;;;2878   			if (ofs > fp->fsize)		/* Clip offset at the file size */
;;;2879   				ofs = fp->fsize;
;;;2880   			fp->fptr = ofs;				/* Set file pointer */
;;;2881   			if (ofs) {
;;;2882   				fp->clust = clmt_clust(fp, ofs - 1);
;;;2883   				dsc = clust2sect(fp->fs, fp->clust);
;;;2884   				if (!dsc) ABORT(fp->fs, FR_INT_ERR);
;;;2885   				dsc += (ofs - 1) / SS(fp->fs) & (fp->fs->csize - 1);
;;;2886   				if (fp->fptr % SS(fp->fs) && dsc != fp->dsect) {	/* Refill sector cache if needed */
;;;2887   #if !_FS_TINY
;;;2888   #if !_FS_READONLY
;;;2889   					if (fp->flag & FA__DIRTY) {		/* Write-back dirty sector cache */
;;;2890   						if (disk_write(fp->fs->drv, fp->buf, fp->dsect, 1) != RES_OK)
;;;2891   							ABORT(fp->fs, FR_DISK_ERR);
;;;2892   						fp->flag &= ~FA__DIRTY;
;;;2893   					}
;;;2894   #endif
;;;2895   					if (disk_read(fp->fs->drv, fp->buf, dsc, 1) != RES_OK)	/* Load current sector */
;;;2896   						ABORT(fp->fs, FR_DISK_ERR);
;;;2897   #endif
;;;2898   					fp->dsect = dsc;
;;;2899   				}
;;;2900   			}
;;;2901   		}
;;;2902   	} else
;;;2903   #endif
;;;2904   
;;;2905   	/* Normal Seek */
;;;2906   	{
;;;2907   		DWORD clst, bcs, nsect, ifptr;
;;;2908   
;;;2909   		if (ofs > fp->fsize					/* In read-only mode, clip offset with the file size */
;;;2910   #if !_FS_READONLY
;;;2911   			 && !(fp->flag & FA_WRITE)
;;;2912   #endif
;;;2913   			) ofs = fp->fsize;
;;;2914   
;;;2915   		ifptr = fp->fptr;
;;;2916   		fp->fptr = nsect = 0;
;;;2917   		if (ofs) {
;;;2918   			bcs = (DWORD)fp->fs->csize * SS(fp->fs);	/* Cluster size (byte) */
;;;2919   			if (ifptr > 0 &&
;;;2920   				(ofs - 1) / bcs >= (ifptr - 1) / bcs) {	/* When seek to same or following cluster, */
;;;2921   				fp->fptr = (ifptr - 1) & ~(bcs - 1);	/* start from the current cluster */
;;;2922   				ofs -= fp->fptr;
;;;2923   				clst = fp->clust;
;;;2924   			} else {									/* When seek to back cluster, */
;;;2925   				clst = fp->sclust;						/* start from the first cluster */
;;;2926   #if !_FS_READONLY
;;;2927   				if (clst == 0) {						/* If no cluster chain, create a new chain */
;;;2928   					clst = create_chain(fp->fs, 0);
;;;2929   					if (clst == 1) ABORT(fp->fs, FR_INT_ERR);
;;;2930   					if (clst == 0xFFFFFFFF) ABORT(fp->fs, FR_DISK_ERR);
;;;2931   					fp->sclust = clst;
;;;2932   				}
;;;2933   #endif
;;;2934   				fp->clust = clst;
;;;2935   			}
;;;2936   			if (clst != 0) {
;;;2937   				while (ofs > bcs) {						/* Cluster following loop */
;;;2938   #if !_FS_READONLY
;;;2939   					if (fp->flag & FA_WRITE) {			/* Check if in write mode or not */
;;;2940   						clst = create_chain(fp->fs, clst);	/* Force stretch if in write mode */
;;;2941   						if (clst == 0) {				/* When disk gets full, clip file size */
;;;2942   							ofs = bcs; break;
;;;2943   						}
;;;2944   					} else
;;;2945   #endif
;;;2946   						clst = get_fat(fp->fs, clst);	/* Follow cluster chain if not in write mode */
;;;2947   					if (clst == 0xFFFFFFFF) ABORT(fp->fs, FR_DISK_ERR);
;;;2948   					if (clst <= 1 || clst >= fp->fs->n_fatent) ABORT(fp->fs, FR_INT_ERR);
;;;2949   					fp->clust = clst;
;;;2950   					fp->fptr += bcs;
;;;2951   					ofs -= bcs;
;;;2952   				}
;;;2953   				fp->fptr += ofs;
;;;2954   				if (ofs % SS(fp->fs)) {
;;;2955   					nsect = clust2sect(fp->fs, clst);	/* Current sector */
;;;2956   					if (!nsect) ABORT(fp->fs, FR_INT_ERR);
;;;2957   					nsect += ofs / SS(fp->fs);
;;;2958   				}

;;;2488   FRESULT f_write (
000000  e92d4fff          PUSH     {r0-r11,lr}

;;;2577   			}

;;;2592   	}
;;;2593

;;;2598   }
